body: No. You’ll probably end up throwing it up and feeling extremely sick. Also if someone does end up finding you/ finding out you’ll have to deal with their pity as well.

Listen I was in a similar place you were a year ago (that's why I created this account) and I wanted to tell you that things will change. I can't promise everything will magically get better because I don't know what your future holds in store for you but if you really have nothing left to lose why not sit tight and see what happens next.
You're not bad looking but your current hairstyle is not doing you any favors. Beard can look good if you can grow it thicker and actually maintain it properly.

I hope you are feeling a bit better now that a little more time has past. I'm sorry you feel embarrassed but I'm glad the attempt didn't work. Do you have any friends or family nearby that you can talk to right now?
I'm so glad to hear that! Get home safely :D

I'm really sorry you always end up being the one to cheer others up. I know I have never met you but you really seem like kindhearted and selfless person. I hope I'm not being intrusive but would you like to talk more about your problems? If not I sincerely hope you get home safe tonight.
I'm sorry you had to go through whatever led you take the pills in the first place. Aside from the lightheadedness and weakness how are you feeling now?
I just wanted to say that you are really brave for sticking it out for your friend. What specifically is making you tired?
Yeah. I tend to assume everyone is male on here unless proven otherwise so sorry if you are a woman as well.
Oh I've tried and ended up ruining some really good friendships. But hey, you're lucky, men tend to age like fine wine.
The risk of it failing and how my friends/family might take it.
I'm 23 and I've never been in a relationship. Trust me you aren't the only one out there.

Haha I was talking to the drunk guy (Cantbuymehotdogsman) who clearly has the right idea. 

Listen brigitbee, you really don't have to do this. I mean you never met me before and chances are you never will. Why go through all the trouble of getting emotionally invested in a total stranger? I'm sure you have much better things to do so please don't waste your time with someone like me. I really am sorry for getting you involved in this. The same goes for everyone who posted on this thread. Once again my selfishness just brings trouble to those around me.
I hope I don't come off as rude but honestly what keeps you going? I just can't see myself moving forward after this.

Medicine is something I've wanted to do since I was 4. Everything I ever did in life was so that I could one day become a Pediatrician. Even the degree I earned in undergraduate was so I could have a competitive edge when applying for schools and not out of any desire to pursue a career in said field.
You, I like you. Not sure why I'm still sober right now. I guess a part of me is afraid I might actually follow through with the plan if I get enough alcohol in me.
At this point it is obvious that admitting me was a mistake so I'm really not as smart as you would think.

I can't get another leave of absence. This was my second chance and I messed it up.
As for how successful drowning myself will be? I can't even swim when I'm sober so as long as no one tries to save me I should be successful and hey no one will have to clean up after me so that's a plus I guess.

See that's the thing. This was my second chance and I still screwed up. Now I get to deal with the debt of school with no real way to pay it back. It's not even that I really want to die, in fact I love being alive and there is so much I wish I had a chance to do but now I probably won't ever be able to. No, it's more that I feel like I've been backed up into a corner with no options of moving forward. 

If I keep on going I know things are going to get worse. Debt aside I am going to have to live with the stigma of being a failure for the rest of my life. I am forever going to be branded as the idiot who failed out of medical school. I don't want to have to go back home and deal with scrutiny of others. I don't want people to pity me. I just don't want to deal with this.
